name: Interim Relief to the Beneficiaries Affected by Disaster (GBOCWWB)
benefit:
An immediate relief of up to ₹10,00,000/-.
_*The committee shall decide about the modalities regarding disbursement of such relief, quantum and procedure to be followed for such disbursement._
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant should be a beneficiary of a scheme of the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
- The applicant should be affected by disaster/catastrophe/natural calamity.
